ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The resistance of the piezoresistor decreases as the pressure it receives increases. A student used a piezoresistor to design a device for judging the motion state of a trolley. Its working principle is as shown in figure (a). The piezoresistor and a baffle are fixed on an insulating trolley, and an insulating heavy ball is placed in the middle. During the process in which the trolley moves in a straight line to the right, the ammeter reading is as shown in figure (b). Which of the following judgments is correct? ( )
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: During the time from t2 to t3, the trolley makes uniformly accelerated linear motion.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In figure (a), the trolley is marked with a motion direction to the right, the vertical component on the left is labeled "piezoresistor", and beside it there is an insulating heavy ball; the piezoresistor is connected into a circuit composed of power supply E, ammeter A, resistor R, etc. The stem explains that the piezoresistor and a baffle are fixed on an insulating trolley, and an insulating heavy ball is placed in the middle. Figure (b) is a graph of current I changing with time t: from 0 to t1 the current is relatively small and constant, from t1 to t2 the current gradually increases, and from t2 to t3 the current is a horizontal segment and remains at a relatively large value. Then reason: The resistance of the piezoresistor decreases as pressure increases. When the power supply voltage is constant, from Ohm's law it can be known that the larger the current, the greater the pressure received by the piezoresistor. The graph from t2 to t3 is a horizontal line, indicating that the current during this time is constant, therefore the pressure received by the piezoresistor is constant; and this current value is higher than the preceding low-current segment, indicating that the pressure during this time is greater than the pressure in the previous low-value stage. Since pressure cannot be negative, it can be judged that the piezoresistor in this segment receives a definite nonzero pressure. The pressure of the heavy ball on the left piezoresistor comes from the heavy ball, due to inertia, squeezing the piezoresistor to the left relative to the trolley when the trolley accelerates to the right, and the magnitude of the pressure corresponds to the magnitude of the acceleration. The pressure is constant and nonzero, indicating that the acceleration of the trolley is constant and directed to the right. The stem explains that the trolley moves in a straight line, therefore from t2 to t3 the trolley makes uniformly accelerated linear motion.
